limitations: This is a bounded local sample, not field Core Web Vitals or physical-device/Safari testing.

Per-page sample count stays below50 interactions, so the sample emphasizes the worst interaction rather than a traffic-level98th percentile.
Instrumentation and this machine/network fixture can affect results. No INP is inferred from Lighthouse TBT.
